quests.title: HTML Ignition: Page Skeleton
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: HTML Ignition — Page Skeleton

**Objective:** Build a valid, minimal HTML document skeleton that can be safely extended.

You’ll edit **`index.html`** to meet the requirements described in the quest README and enforced by the public tests.

objectives.text: Document includes `<!doctype html>` and a single `<html>` root element.
Head/body are present and ordered correctly.
objectives.why: Correct base structure for browsers and tools.

objectives.text: Required app root element exists (per README).
objectives.why: Stable hook for future UI work.

objectives.text: No placeholder TODO text remains in the final markup.

quests.lore_md:
## Browser Boot Log

> *Booting renderer…*
>
> The page can’t initialize — the skeleton is incomplete.

Your job is to restore the **minimum valid HTML structure** so the rest of the UI can mount.

tiered_hints.concept: A valid HTML document starts with `<!doctype html>` and a single `<html>` root containing `<head>` and `<body>`.
tiered_hints.guided: Open `workspace/index.html` and match the README requirements exactly. Ensure the app/root element exists and remove TODO placeholders.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Build a minimal document: doctype + html + head + body, then add the required root element exactly as specified in README.

quests.title: Tags & Attributes
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Tags & Attributes

**Objective:** Use the correct HTML tags and attributes to express meaning and behavior.

Edit **`index.html`**. Your output must match the README spec and pass the tests.

objectives.text: Use the required tags for the required content (per README).
Apply required attributes (ids/classes/data-*, href/src, etc.) correctly.
objectives.why: Attributes drive linking, styling, and automation.

objectives.text: Keep nesting valid (no impossible parent/child combos).
objectives.why: Invalid nesting breaks tooling and accessibility.

objectives.text: Remove all TODO placeholder text.

quests.lore_md:
## DOM Diagnostic

> Tags are miswired.
> Attributes are missing.

The inspector can’t reliably identify elements. Repair the markup so the system can target the right nodes.

tiered_hints.concept: Tags communicate meaning; attributes provide identifiers, links, sources, and metadata.
tiered_hints.guided: Follow README literally. If a test expects an attribute, ensure spelling/casing/quotes match exactly.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required elements and attributes exactly as specified; validate nesting and remove placeholders.

quests.title: Links & Images
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Links & Images

**Objective:** Add navigation and imagery using correct elements and required attributes.

Edit **`index.html`** and satisfy the README spec.

objectives.text: Create required `<a>` links with correct `href` targets.
objectives.why: Navigation must be explicit and testable.

objectives.text: Add required `` elements with correct `src` and `alt`.
objectives.why: Images must be accessible and valid.

objectives.text: Use any required `target`/`rel` attributes (if specified).
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Navigation Layer

> Hyperlinks missing.
> Media pipeline incomplete.

Restore the routes and visuals so the page can connect to the rest of the system.

tiered_hints.concept: Links use ``. Images use `` (alt is not optional for accessibility).
tiered_hints.guided: Check README for exact URLs/text. Pay attention to required attribute values and quoting.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Add the required anchors and images with exact attributes and accessible alt text.

quests.title: Lists & Tables
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Lists & Tables

**Objective:** Represent structured data correctly using lists and tables.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Use `<ul>/<ol>` with `<li>` for list content (per README).
objectives.why: Lists must be semantic, not fake-divs.

objectives.text: Build a valid `<table>` with correct rows/cells (per README).
objectives.why: Tabular data must be properly encoded.

objectives.text: Use headers `<th>` where required.
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Data Layout Console

> Structured data corrupted.

Rebuild the list + table layer so the UI can render and interpret data reliably.

tiered_hints.concept: Lists are for collections; tables are for row/column relationships.
tiered_hints.guided: Follow README for exact item text and table structure. Ensure correct tags and nesting.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required list(s) and table with the exact structure and content from the spec.

quests.title: Forms & Inputs
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Forms & Inputs

**Objective:** Create a functional form using correct inputs, labels, and attributes.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Form exists with required fields and correct input types.
objectives.why: Correct types drive UX and validation.

objectives.text: Labels are correctly associated (for/id or nesting).
Required attributes are present (name, placeholder, required, etc.).
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Input System

> Form controls offline.

Wire up the form correctly so the interface can collect data without ambiguity.

tiered_hints.concept: Inputs should have `name` and labels should be associated for accessibility.
tiered_hints.guided: Match README: types, names, ids, and required fields must match exactly.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Build the form as specified with proper labels, input types, and required attributes.

quests.title: Semantic Layout
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Semantic Layout

**Objective:** Replace generic layout markup with semantic page structure.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Use semantic containers required by the README (header/nav/main/footer/etc.).
Keep heading hierarchy consistent.
Preserve required ids/classes/data-testid hooks.
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Layout Engine

> The page outline is incoherent.

Refactor the structure into semantic sections so tools and users can navigate it.

tiered_hints.concept: Semantic tags describe purpose (header/nav/main/footer/section/article/aside).
tiered_hints.guided: Don’t remove required hooks—only change tags/structure as needed to satisfy the semantic spec.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the semantic structure described in README while preserving required element identifiers.

quests.title: Accessibility Basics
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Accessibility Basics

**Objective:** Add essential accessibility attributes and patterns.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: All images have meaningful `alt` text (per README).
Form controls have labels.
Interactive elements use correct tags (button/link).
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Accessibility Scan

> Assistive tech can’t interpret the interface.

Patch the missing accessibility signals so the UI is usable for everyone.

tiered_hints.concept: Accessibility is mostly: correct elements + labels + alt text.
tiered_hints.guided: If something is clickable, it should usually be a `<button>` or `<a>`. Ensure required alt/labels match the spec.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required accessibility attributes and semantic interactive elements exactly as specified.

quests.title: Media & Embeds
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Media & Embeds

**Objective:** Embed media using correct tags and required attributes.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Add required `<video>`/`<audio>`/`<iframe>` embeds (per README).
Use required attributes (controls, src, width/height, title, etc.).
Provide fallback text if required.
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Media Subsystem

> Embedded content not loading.

Restore the media nodes so the interface can stream and render external content.

tiered_hints.concept: Use native elements for media. If embedding external content, add a `title` for accessibility.
tiered_hints.guided: Follow README for exact tags + attributes. Missing a single attribute will fail tests.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Add the required embed(s) with all required attributes and any required fallback text.

quests.title: Metadata & SEO Basics
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Metadata & SEO Basics

**Objective:** Add correct metadata in the document head.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Set the required `<title>`.
Add required `<meta>` tags (charset, viewport, description, etc.).
Include any required OpenGraph/Twitter metadata (if specified).
No placeholder TODO content remains.

quests.lore_md:
## Head Metadata

> Crawlers can’t classify the page.

Repair the head metadata so browsers and indexers can understand what this page is.

tiered_hints.concept: Metadata lives in `<head>`: title and meta tags. Charset + viewport are common essentials.
tiered_hints.guided: Check README for exact meta names/values. Tests usually match strings exactly.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Add the required title and meta tags in `<head>` with the exact attribute values.

quests.title: Debug & Validate HTML
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Debug & Validate HTML

**Objective:** Fix common HTML validation issues: missing closing tags, invalid nesting, and malformed attributes.

Edit **`index.html`**.

objectives.text: Fix the broken markup patterns described in README.
Ensure required nodes still exist after fixes.
Avoid invalid nesting and missing closers.
Remove placeholder TODO content.

quests.lore_md:
## Validator Output

> Fatal parse warnings detected.

The document is technically “rendering,” but it’s unstable. Patch the markup until the validator stops screaming.

tiered_hints.concept: Most HTML bugs are missing closing tags, invalid nesting, or malformed attributes.
tiered_hints.guided: Work one failing requirement at a time. After each change, re-check the surrounding structure to avoid new nesting errors.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Correct the malformed tags/attributes so structure and required content match the README exactly.

quests.title: CSS Ignition: Your First Styles
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: CSS Ignition — Your First Styles

**Objective:** Apply basic CSS rules to achieve the required appearance.

Edit **`style.css`**. Tests validate that required selectors and declarations exist.

objectives.text: Write the required ensure-style rules as described in README.
Use correct property names and valid values.
Keep the file clean: remove TODO placeholders.
Do not add extra frameworks or preprocessors.

quests.lore_md:
## Stylesheet Boot

> Styles missing.

The page loads, but it’s unstyled. Bring the UI online by writing the first real CSS rules.

tiered_hints.concept: CSS = selector { property: value; }. Properties must be spelled correctly.
tiered_hints.guided: Start from the selectors mentioned in README. Then add the required declarations exactly.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required selectors and declarations in `style.css` until tests pass.

quests.title: Selectors & Specificity
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Selectors & Specificity

**Objective:** Target elements with correct selectors and resolve conflicts using specificity.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Implement required selectors (class/id/attribute/descendant, per README).
Ensure the “winning” rule is the intended one.
Avoid `!important` unless the README explicitly requires it.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Cascade Conflict

> Multiple rules apply. Output is unstable.

Resolve the selector conflicts so the UI gets the correct final styles.

tiered_hints.concept: Specificity: id > class/attr > element. Later rules win when specificity ties.
tiered_hints.guided: Find the conflicting selectors in `style.css` and adjust specificity the simplest way.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Use correct selectors and ordering so the expected declaration wins without hacks.

quests.title: Cascade & Inheritance
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Cascade & Inheritance

**Objective:** Predict and control which styles apply through inheritance and cascade.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Use inheritance intentionally (per README).
Override inherited styles where required.
Order rules so the correct ones win.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Style Propagation

> Styles leak into components.

Control the inheritance chain so only the intended elements inherit the intended styles.

tiered_hints.concept: Some properties inherit (color, font). Others don’t (margin, padding, border).
tiered_hints.guided: Set a base style on a parent, then override only what the README requires on children.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Use a base rule + targeted overrides to achieve the expected style outcomes.

quests.title: The Box Model
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: The Box Model

**Objective:** Use margin, padding, border, and sizing rules correctly.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Apply required padding/margins/borders (per README).
Use `box-sizing` where needed.
Use shorthand properties correctly.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Layout Geometry

> Boxes don’t align.

Fix the spacing geometry so the UI’s boxes match the intended dimensions.

tiered_hints.concept: Box model: content → padding → border → margin. `box-sizing: border-box` changes how width/height are computed.
tiered_hints.guided: Start with the properties explicitly mentioned in README; then fix sizing issues using box-sizing if required.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required box model rules until tests find the expected declarations.

quests.title: Units & Typography
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Units & Typography

**Objective:** Use correct units and typography properties to style text.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Use the required unit types (px/rem/em/%/vh/vw) per README.
Apply required typography styles (font-size/weight/line-height/etc.).
Prefer rem for scalable text if required by README.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Text Rendering

> Typography scale unstable.

Normalize the text system using the correct units so the UI reads cleanly at different sizes.

tiered_hints.concept: rem scales with the root font size; em scales with the current element’s font size.
tiered_hints.guided: Follow the unit requirements in README exactly. Tests usually search for specific properties/values.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the typography rules with the correct units and declarations as specified.

quests.title: Colors & Backgrounds
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Colors & Backgrounds

**Objective:** Apply color and background rules correctly.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Apply required text colors and background colors.
Use correct color formats as required (hex/rgb/hsl).
objectives.why: CSS accepts multiple formats; tests may enforce one.

objectives.text: Use background properties correctly (image/size/repeat/position) if specified.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Theme Layer

> Colors not applied.

Restore the palette and background rules so the interface matches its intended theme.

tiered_hints.concept: Use `color` for text and `background-color`/`background` for surfaces.
tiered_hints.guided: If README specifies exact values or formats, match them precisely.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the color/background rules exactly as required until tests pass.

quests.title: Flexbox Layout
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Flexbox Layout

**Objective:** Lay out items using Flexbox properties.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Create a flex container on the required element.
Use alignment properties (justify/align/gap) as required.
Apply flex sizing rules if required (flex, flex-basis, etc.).
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Layout Engine: Flex

> Items collapse and drift.

Activate the flex layout so components line up correctly.

tiered_hints.concept: Flexbox starts with `display: flex` on a container, then you align items with justify/align properties.
tiered_hints.guided: Implement `display: flex` first, then apply the exact alignment properties required by README.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Add the required flex container + alignment declarations until tests find them.

quests.title: Grid Layout
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Grid Layout

**Objective:** Create a grid layout using CSS Grid.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Create a grid container with `display: grid` on the required selector.
objectives.why: Grid layout requires a grid container.

objectives.text: Define columns/rows with template properties.
Place items using grid placement rules if required.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Layout Engine: Grid

> The interface needs a stable grid.

Configure the grid tracks so content lands in the right columns and rows.

tiered_hints.concept: Grid starts with `display: grid`, then `grid-template-columns/rows` to define tracks.
tiered_hints.guided: Implement the template tracks first, then add any required gaps/placements.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Define the required grid container + templates until tests pass.

quests.title: Responsive Design & Media Queries
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Responsive Design & Media Queries

**Objective:** Add responsive styles that activate at specific breakpoints.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Add the required media query breakpoints.
objectives.why: Responsive behavior depends on correct conditions.

objectives.text: Change the required properties inside the media query blocks.
Keep base styles outside media queries.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Adaptive UI

> Layout fails on small screens.

Add breakpoint rules so the UI adapts cleanly to different viewport sizes.

tiered_hints.concept: Media queries look like `@media (min-width: 600px) { ... }` and override styles inside the block.
tiered_hints.guided: Match the exact breakpoint conditions required by README. Put only the required overrides in the media blocks.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Add the required `@media` blocks and override the required properties.

quests.title: Positioning & Z-Index
quests.briefing_md:
# Mission: Positioning & Z-Index

**Objective:** Position elements using relative/absolute/fixed/sticky and manage stacking order.

Edit **`style.css`**.

objectives.text: Apply the required positioning mode(s) to the required selectors.
Use top/left/right/bottom offsets as required.
Use z-index correctly when stacking is required.
Remove TODO placeholders.

quests.lore_md:
## Stacking Context

> Elements overlap incorrectly.

Fix positioning and stacking so the UI layers as intended.

tiered_hints.concept: z-index only works on positioned elements and within stacking contexts.
tiered_hints.guided: Apply the required `position` first, then add offsets, then add z-index if required.
tiered_hints.full_solution: Implement the required positioning + z-index declarations exactly as required.
